set_asset_help: Variant settings live in an asset so that the blueprint ID assigned on upload can be saved from script. Nothing is lost if you forget to save the scene.
no_avatar_root: No avatar root (VRCAvatarDescriptor) found. Place this component under an avatar.
scene_untouched_help: The scene always holds the full configuration. Switching only changes the blueprint ID; removals, material swaps and blend shape values are applied to the build copy at build time.
pending_banner:
'{0}' is queued to be uploaded as a new avatar.
Building and uploading now creates a new avatar from this variant.
The assigned blueprint ID is written back to this variant and saved automatically.
delete_dialog_message: Delete the settings for '{0}'. (Undo will restore them.)
operations_header: Operations applied when building this variant
outside_avatar_pick: [Avatar Variant] '{0}' is outside the avatar and cannot be used.
outside_avatar_drop: [Avatar Variant] '{0}' is outside the avatar and was not added.
allow_unmatched: Build even when no variant matches
warn_duplicate_id: Blueprint ID '{0}' is used by more than one variant.
warn_remove_missing: '{0}': removal target '{1}' was not found. The build will fail.
warn_material_missing: '{0}': material swap target '{1}' was not found, or has no Renderer.
warn_material_slot: '{0}': material swap on '{1}' uses slot {2}, which is out of range ({3} slots).
warn_shape_no_renderer: '{0}': blend shape target '{1}' was not found, or has no SkinnedMeshRenderer.
warn_allow_unmatched: 'Build even when no variant matches' is enabled. This disables the safeguard against uploading the wrong content; avoid leaving it on.
log_marked_pending: [Avatar Variant] '{0}' is queued for a new upload. The blueprint ID was cleared, so the next upload creates a new avatar.
log_wrote_back: [Avatar Variant] Wrote the assigned blueprint ID back to variant '{0}' and saved it ({1}).
asset_edit_hint:
Edit this from the Avatar Variant Selector on the avatar.
Targets are stored as paths relative to the avatar root, so they cannot be resolved or picked without an avatar for context.
asset_select_user: Select the avatar using this asset
asset_user_not_found: [Avatar Variant] No avatar referencing this asset was found in the open scenes.
build_multiple_selectors: [Avatar Variant] '{0}' has {1} AvatarVariantSelector components. Exactly one is expected.
build_no_set: [Avatar Variant] The AvatarVariantSelector on '{0}' has no variant set asset assigned.
build_hint_new: To upload as a new avatar, press 'Upload as a new avatar' for that variant in the Avatar Variant Selector.
build_hint_switch: Pick a variant again in the Avatar Variant Selector.
build_allow_unmatched_warn: [Avatar Variant] The blueprint ID matches no variant. Building the scene as-is because 'Build even when no variant matches' is enabled.
build_via_pending: [Avatar Variant] The blueprint ID is unassigned, so building as the queued new-upload variant '{0}'.
build_remove_missing: [Avatar Variant] '{0}': removal target '{1}' was not found. A rename or reparent may have broken the path. The build was stopped so that content you meant to strip is not uploaded.
build_target_missing: [Avatar Variant] '{0}': target '{1}' was not found. A rename or reparent may have broken the path.
build_slot_out_of_range: [Avatar Variant] '{0}': material slot {2} on '{1}' is out of range ({3} slots).
build_shape_missing: [Avatar Variant] '{0}': '{1}' has no blend shape named '{2}'.
build_done: [Avatar Variant] Built variant '{0}' ({1} object(s) removed, {2} material slot(s) overridden, {3} blend shape(s) set).
